name: JAI Chateau Hotels & Hostels
detail: It is just a little over a 10-minute walk from the center of tourism, like Lin Department Store. It’s hot, but you can enjoy walking while taking a break at the shaved ice shop along the way. There is a Seven-Eleven in the same building, which is very convenient, and diagonally across is a Watsons drugstore, where you can buy souvenirs like white flower oil or get cosmetics if you forget something. The front staff spoke Japanese very fluently, and I had no issues at all. The light snacks at the lounge from 6 PM were also very delicious. The breakfast lineup was diverse, featuring natto, bread, cheese, and Taiwanese-style meals, so I never got bored. Amenities included shampoo, conditioner, body soap, hand soap, bathrobe, and disposable slippers. You can flush an appropriate amount of toilet paper, and there was also a washlet. Overall, I think it’s a clean and wonderful hotel. I recommend it.

name: Shangri-La Far Eastern Plaza, Tainan
detail: A comfortable stay with excellent location right next to the train station and decent mall. Rooms are clean and spacious and bathroom is also very spacious. The outdoor pool on 3rd floor has great view of the sunset. Overall it was an enjoyable stay though the price is on the higher end

name: XIUXI ANPING
detail: Located in Anping, it's surrounded by many attractions and has a quiet and comfortable atmosphere. It's easy to get to the city center by taxi (about 15-20 minutes), and I appreciated the fresh coffee and Taiwanese tea provided daily. The room size is very large, and the toilet and bathroom are separate, which is convenient! There are water purifiers on each floor, and you can freely use sparkling water as well! I would definitely consider visiting again ❤️

name: Tainan Island Heart
detail: The Tainan Station is a bit far, but the Wusheng Night Market is nearby, and I enjoyed walking around Shennong Street, Yongle Market, and Huayuan Night Market as well. Additionally, there is a highly rated restaurant called Jiayi Dazhang Mianxian just a few doors down from the accommodation, and across the street, there is a noodle shop called Aqin Mian Dian, so the location is great! I stayed in a dormitory, and the facilities were clean, with spacious beds where I could store my luggage at my feet. Also, I believe the lockers with locks can fit a carry-on suitcase. The shower room and restroom in the shared space were kept clean, which made them pleasant to use. The view from the rooftop kitchen lounge was nice, and I was able to relax and eat takeout food there. I definitely want to use it again when I come back to Tainan. It also offers great value for the price!

name: U.I.J Hotel&Hostel (UIJ)
detail: I was surprised because I had stayed at several hostels and other cheap small accommodations before coming here. Everywhere in the building, including the restrooms and hallways, the air conditioning works! It’s so effective that you feel like you want to cover yourself with a blanket! The common area is spacious and comfortable. There are plenty of clean restrooms. The showers provide hot water, and there is even a small changing area. All the staff are very friendly. I arrived here by bicycle after climbing Mt. Tamayama, so I looked messy and dirty... Above all, I am grateful that English is properly understood! I was allowed to park my bicycle in the underground bike parking area, and there are shops right in front. People used to Japanese hotels might feel this is normal, but for backpackers, it’s the best. Since it's a dormitory, the type of people in the same room is based on luck, but there were only two bunk beds in a fairly spacious room, and I was extremely tired, so it was very comfortable and I slept soundly until morning. I will definitely stay here again!

name: Old Man Captain Hostel II
detail: The price and location are very good. As many reviews mention, the entrance is inside the FamilyMart located immediately to the left after exiting the ticket gates of Tainan Station. The washing machine is free, and the dryer can be used for NT50, which is appreciated by long-term guests. However, each floor only has two toilets and showers, and on the upper floors, one of them cannot be locked, effectively leaving only one available. Since the toilet and shower are combined, the toilet is often flooded after the evening. Additionally, towels are available for rent at NT20 or you can bring your own.

name: Quiet Hostel - Minquan Inn(清淨背包客棧-民權新館)
detail: Good hostel in central location. Walking distance to Confucius temple. Some snacks provided and welcome fruit on arrival. No elevator so you’ll be climbing stairs but no issue

name: Grand Banyan Hotel
detail: I heard it was a 4-star hotel, and it was just as I expected. The front desk had staff fluent in Japanese who kindly explained how to use the facilities and the important points to note. They also changed my room to one with a bathtub. The guest room was spacious and clean. The bed was large, and the two-seater sofa was comfortable. The bathroom and toilet were separate, and the toilet had a washlet. Breakfast was also very diverse, and I enjoyed it three times without getting bored. It is within walking distance from Tainan Station, and I definitely want to repeat my visit if I have another trip to Tainan.

name: The Restro
detail: Anyway, the facilities are great. The beds can surprisingly be used in both the upper and lower tiers. You can sleep on the upper tier and use the lower one for placing items or hanging clothes. There are also two large lockers that can be used up and down. The facility is clean and spacious, and there are no issues with the shower rooms, which are also wide and easy to use. The staff is very friendly and attentive to everything. The dormitory is managed by a hotel next door, but the quality of service and linens is at a hotel level. It’s not just a dormitory, nor is the hotel attracting cheap guests by converting some rooms into dorms; rather, they are operating the dormitory next door using the hotel’s expertise and staff… this is why such service and low prices are possible.

name: Fuqi Hostel - Heping
detail: The atmosphere is relaxing, warm, and conservatively integrated with Tainan city. It is close to tourist attractions and major roads, making it easy to travel to different places. There are separate rooms for women that are clearly defined and safe. A code is required to access the room to enter the women's dormitory.
